name: High Enchanter Thalos
role: Head of Prismspire Academy, Golemancer, Council Member
title: High Enchanter
bio: Master golemancer and head of the Prismspire Academy. Oversees all magical research, golem R&D, dreamcrafting divisions, and elite trainee programs. Brilliant but can be condescending to non-magical folk.
motivation: Advance the boundaries of golemcraft and arcane research while maintaining Prismspire's academic standards.
